subject: general
question: Who received the Dronacharya Award for outstanding coaches in Sports and Games 2024 in the Lifetime Category?

options.text: Shri Murlikant Rajaram Petkar and Shri Sucha Singh
Shri S. Muralidharan and Shri Armando Agnelo Colaco
Shri Gukesh D, Shri Harmanpreet Singh, and Ms. Manu Bhaker
Shri Subhash Rana, Ms. Deepali Deshpande, and Shri Sandeep Sangwan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri S. Muralidharan and Shri Armando Agnelo Colaco**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dronacharya Award (Lifetime Category):** This award is presented to coaches who have made exceptional and long-term contributions to sports training.
 
• **Awardees for 2024:** Shri S. Muralidharan (Badminton) and Shri Armando Agnelo Colaco (Football).
 
• **Contribution of Shri S. Muralidharan:** Recognized for his dedication to badminton coaching and nurturing many national and international players over his career.
 
• **Contribution of Shri Armando Agnelo Colaco:** A renowned football coach who has significantly contributed to the development of football in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dronacharya Award (Regular Category):**

 
 
• Awarded to Shri Subhash Rana (Para-Shooting), Ms. Deepali Deshpande (Shooting), and Shri Sandeep Sangwan (Hockey).
 
• Recognizes consistent efforts in training athletes to excel at international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2024:**
 
 
• Awarded to Shri Gukesh D (Chess), Shri Harmanpreet Singh (Hockey), Shri Praveen Kumar (Para-Athletics), and Ms. Manu Bhaker (Shooting).
 
• This award honors the most outstanding performances in sports over the past four years.
 
 
 
• **Arjuna Awards (Lifetime) 2024:**
 
 
• Presented to Shri Murlikant Rajaram Petkar (Para-Swimming) and Shri Sucha Singh (Athletics).
 
• Recognizes lifetime achievements and contributions to the promotion of sports.
 
 
 
• **Selection Process:**
 
 
• The awards are decided by a selection committee chaired by Justice (Retd.) V. Ramasubramanian.
 
• The committee includes distinguished sportspersons, administrators, and journalists.
